title: SurveyMonkey connector is available in Beta
body:
The managed [SurveyMonkey connector](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/surveymonkey) is now available in Lakeflow Connect in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the **Previews** page.

Use the connector to ingest surveys, survey structure, collectors, survey responses, and contacts from SurveyMonkey into Databricks. The connector uses OAuth user-to-machine (U2M) authentication and supports incremental ingestion, UI-based pipeline authoring, Declarative Automation Bundles, and API-based pipeline authoring.
